from scipy.special import erf
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
M = np.load(WORK/'pass_4/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
para = np.repeat(np.arange(32)[:,None], M.shape[1], 1)[M]
tr = para%4!=0; te = ~tr
for Lr in [1,3,5]:
    pre = f"roberta.encoder.layer.{Lr}."
    W1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight"); b1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias")
    W2 = base(pre+"output.dense.weight"); b2 = base(pre+"output.dense.bias")
    if Lr<5:
        A = np.load(WORK/f'ffn_in_L{Lr}.npy'); trm, tem = tr, te
    else:
        A = np.load(WORK/'ffn_in_L5_cls.npy'); idx = np.arange(len(A)); trm = idx%4!=0; tem = ~trm
    H = gelu(A@W1.T + b1); R = A + H@W2.T + b2; Rc = R - R.mean(1, keepdims=True)
    var = H[trm].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0)
    line=[]
    for m in [512,1024,1536]:
        keep = np.argsort(-var)[:m]; drop = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(3072), keep)
        Hk = H[:,keep]; mk = Hk[trm].mean(0); T = H[:,drop]@W2[:,drop].T; mt = T[trm].mean(0)
        Xk = Hk[trm]-mk; Tt = T[trm]-mt
        G = Xk.T@Xk
        for lam_rel in [1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1]:
            lam = lam_rel*np.trace(G)/m
            B = np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.eye(m), Xk.T@Tt)
            D = T[tem]-mt - (Hk[tem]-mk)@B
            Dc = D - D.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            rel = np.linalg.norm(Dc,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(Rc[tem],axis=1)
            line.append(f"m{m} lam{lam_rel}:{rel.mean():.3f}")
    print(f"L{Lr}: "+' '.join(line))
